modelAnswer:
Youth and Me

Congratulations to Youth on its tenth birthday! As a loyal reader, I'd like to share what it has meant to me.

I first picked up a copy in Senior One, hoping to improve my English. Soon I was hooked, and reading it every Friday has become a habit.

My favourite column is Campus Voices, where students write about their own lives. Last spring, a story about a shy girl who joined the debate team gave me the courage to speak up in class.

I hope Youth will give more students a chance to be heard, perhaps by adding a column for book reviews. Happy birthday, Youth, and here's to the next ten years!

taskRequires: 给校英文报 Youth 投稿，庆祝创刊十周年；读者是编辑和全校读者，用第一人称写自己与报纸的故事。
三个要点：读报的经历、喜爱的栏目、期望和祝福；标题 Youth and Me 照题面写在最上面，这是短文不是书信，不加称呼和署名。
taskCard.thisEssayChooses: 本文自拟了细节：高一偶然开始读、每周五读报的习惯、名为 Campus Voices 的学生来稿栏目，以及读到一篇文章后加入辩论队的经历；期望落在“多给学生发声的版面、加一个书评栏目”。栏目名、具体经历和建议都可以换成你自己的，但要具体，经历和栏目最好能连成一件事。语气是一个真诚的老读者，开头祝贺，结尾祝福。

notes.role: 开头先祝贺十周年，再交代“我”是谁、要讲什么，读者一眼知道这是一篇读者投稿。

items.quote: Congratulations to Youth on its tenth birthday!
items.explain: 一句话同时回应“庆祝创刊十周年”的场合和读者对象，比先写“我是某某”更快进入正题。

items.quote: what it has meant to me
items.explain: 用现在完成时 has meant 说报纸对“我”一直以来的意义，点出全文中心：报纸和我的关系，正好扣住标题 Youth and Me。

notes.role: 写读报经历：从什么时候、为什么开始读，到读成了习惯。

items.explain: 现在分词短语交代最初读报的目的，一个高中生读英文报的真实理由，不用编大道理。
短短几个词写出转变：本来为了学英语，后来真的读入了迷。hooked（入迷）是地道的口语词，比 I liked it very much 生动。

items.quote: reading it every Friday has become a habit
items.explain: “每周五”这个具体时间让经历有画面感；动名词短语作主语，配 has become 说明这个习惯一直持续到现在。

notes.role: 写喜爱的栏目：先点名栏目，再用一件事说明为什么喜欢。

items.quote: My favourite column is Campus Voices, where students write about their own lives.
items.explain: 开门见山点出栏目名，where 引导的定语从句顺带介绍它写什么，读者不用猜。

items.quote: a story about a shy girl who joined the debate team
items.explain: 喜欢的理由不写“很有趣、很有用”，而是讲一篇具体文章，读者信得过。

items.quote: gave me the courage to speak up in class
items.explain: 写出栏目对“我”的实际影响，喜欢的理由落在自己的变化上；speak up 是“大胆说出来”的常用搭配。

notes.role: 写期望和祝福：先提一个具体可做的建议，再送上祝福收尾。

items.quote: perhaps by adding a column for book reviews
items.explain: 期望不停在“越办越好”，而是给编辑一个能马上考虑的建议；perhaps 让建议听起来客气。

items.quote: here's to the next ten years
items.explain: here's to 是祝酒时说的“为……干杯”，用在周年庆的结尾既有分寸又呼应“十周年”。

expressions.function: 说某样东西对自己一直以来的意义，适合周年、毕业、告别这类回顾性的投稿开头。
写自己从随便看看到读入迷的转变，让读报经历有起伏。

expressions.expression: Happy birthday, ... and here's to the next ten years!
expressions.function: 周年庆投稿的祝福结尾，把祝福和“下一个十年”连在一起。

advanced.essay:
Youth and Me

As Youth celebrates its tenth birthday, I want to thank a friend that has been with me all through senior high.

I came across Youth in Senior One, when someone left a copy on my desk. I only meant to flip through it, but I ended up reading it from cover to cover. Since then, every Friday has meant a fresh issue and a lively chat with my deskmate.

What I look forward to most is Campus Voices, a column written by students for students. Last spring, I read a piece by a girl too shy to speak in class until she joined the debate team. Her story spoke to me, and I signed up too.

I hope Youth will open its pages to more student writers, maybe with a column for book reviews. Happy birthday, Youth! May you inspire readers like me for years to come.

pointMap.quote: I came across Youth in Senior One, when someone left a copy on my desk.
Since then, every Friday has meant a fresh issue and a lively chat with my deskmate.
What I look forward to most is Campus Voices, a column written by students for students.
I hope Youth will open its pages to more student writers, maybe with a column for book reviews.
May you inspire readers like me for years to come.

beyondStandard.quote: I want to thank a friend that has been with me all through senior high
beyondStandard.explain: 把报纸说成陪伴“我”整个高中的朋友，比标准版的“分享它对我的意义”更贴近读者和报纸的关系，也给全文定下感谢的基调。

beyondStandard.quote: I only meant to flip through it, but I ended up reading it from cover to cover.
beyondStandard.explain: flip through（随手翻翻）和 from cover to cover（从头读到尾）一前一后形成对比，把“读入迷”写成一个看得见的动作，比 Soon I was hooked 更具体。

beyondStandard.quote: a column written by students for students
beyondStandard.explain: 同位语用 by ... for ... 的对称结构，一句话说清栏目的特点，也暗示了喜欢它的原因：读到的是和自己一样的人。
